steps.label: Resolver
steps.sub: your device asks it; it does all the legwork

steps.label: Authoritative
steps.sub: gives the real A record answer

code:
A       name -> IPv4 address
AAAA    name -> IPv6 address
CNAME   alias -> another name
MX      which mail server, in priority order
TXT     free-form (SPF/DKIM verification)
NS      authoritative name servers
caption: A CNAME must still resolve to an A/AAAA record before it's a usable address.

code:
$ dig www.example.com

;; ANSWER SECTION:
www.example.com.   299   IN   A   93.184.216.34
caption: 299 is the TTL remaining, in seconds — proof the answer came from cache.

steps.label: Low TTL
steps.sub: changes propagate fast, more load on the server

steps.label: High TTL
steps.sub: less load, but old answers linger for longer

steps.label: Cutover plan
steps.sub: lower the TTL days before you change the record
